violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: container used for proofing bread dough.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. Person in charge set up three compartment sink and sanitized equipment.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floor wall junctions throughout the kitchen are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Person in charge will increase cleaning frequency of kitchen. Assessment of compliance will be conducted during the next routine inspection.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE’S OPEN MUG OF WHITE FLUID ON THE PREP COUNTER IN THE BACK.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. CDI: EMPLOYEE RE-EDUCATED, MUG MOVED TO DINING AREA.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: MULTIPLE SQUEEZE BOTTLES
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CDI: SQUEEZE BOTTLES LABELED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED BOWLS IN DRY FOOD (DRIED CHICKPEAS) INSTEAD OF SCOOPS AND A BRUSH IN AMBIENT TEMPERATURE WATER
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI: PIC RE-EDUCATED AND AWARE HE MUST BUY SCOOPS. WATER DUMPED. IF YOU WANT TO KEEP A UTENSIL IN WATER, IT MUST BE 135F OR ABOVE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: OBSERVED FOIL AND MASKING TAPE LINING SHELVES IN PREP AREA. OBSERVED FOIL LINING SHELF ON COOKLINE. OBSERVED CARDBOARD LINING THREE-DOOR STAND-UP COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. CDI: FOIL AND CARDBOARD REMOVED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: Observed employee clothing and other possessions stored in areas that may contaminate food, food-contact surfaces of equipment, single-service items, or single- use items. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE PURSE AND BANDAIDS STORED WITH SINGLE-USE ITEMS. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE PHONE ON CUTTING BOARD.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. CDI: EMPLOYEES RE-EDUCATED AND ITEMS MOVED DURING INSPECTION. BREAD & KABOB (Inspection Date: 02/13/2026) Page 2 of 3
